summary: P6 closes the verified public MCP Guard mutation and projection-quality defects in AlembicPlugin commits a39c2fa (RED test) and 45c4d4f (implementation). Public alembic_code_guard now analyzes only a confined request snapshot: its violations store and Guard hit/adoption methods are observe-only, no live effect flush exists, and observed Prime alignment reports feedbackRecorded=false without consuming the session feedback id. Non-public owning containers retain their existing writable behavior. projectGuardPublicResult is decomposed into bounded rule/violation/status/summary projectors and the exact output/handler Guard scope passes with zero violations. Passing, violating, primeRef, out-of-root, and no-KB tests preserve complete coverage, real violations, applicable Recipe rules, confinement and schemas. Final full unit is 140 files/1541 tests; check, build, package/distribution/plugin verification and a fresh public Host MCP Guard fingerprint all pass. Final dist provenance is Plugin 45c4d4f192a97e4a6dcfc767d031ac7feecaf526 / Core ce1a29a16bbc7239b3fdfedc466fef6c45e02c44.
